fusions.name: Thrown Spar
fusions.desc: Hurls a length of branching coral up to 8 tiles that deals 30 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach, and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Planted Stakes
fusions.desc: Plants a row of coral spears 4 tiles long for 6 seconds. The row deals 12 damage to every enemy that touches it and knocks each back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Standing Spire
fusions.desc: Raises a coral spire for 20 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds it hurls a spine at an enemy within 6 tiles for 7 damage.

fusions.name: Closing Distance
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 15% more damage.
